short_blurb: From remodels to ground-up builds — your Bell Gardens general contractor.
local_note: Bell Gardens homeowners choose Palm Crest Builders for kitchen and bath remodels, room additions, ADUs, and whole-home renovations. We know the local building department, design for Bell Gardens's mix of housing styles, and manage design, permits, and construction with our own licensed crews. We build throughout Bell Gardens, including Bell Gardens proper, Bell adjacent, Downey adjacent, and nearby neighborhoods. Every project is built to the California Building Code and backed by our workmanship warranty.

faqs.q: Do you pull building permits in Bell Gardens?
faqs.a: Yes — we handle plans, plan check, and permits through the Bell Gardens building and safety department for every remodel, addition, and ADU, and we schedule all required inspections.

faqs.q: Can I build an ADU in Bell Gardens?
faqs.a: In most cases, yes. Under California and Bell Gardens rules, most single-family lots qualify for a detached, attached, or garage-conversion ADU. We handle feasibility, design, permits, and construction.

faqs.q: How long will my Bell Gardens remodel or addition take?
faqs.a: It depends on scope — bathrooms typically run 3–5 weeks, kitchens 4–8 weeks, and room additions 2–4 months. We give you a firm schedule with milestones in your written estimate.
